_comment: Foodie research/import template (v1.1.0). Copy rows[] entries and fill ONLY fields you actually captured, each with its own source where practical. Every missing field stays null/empty — never guess, never infer, never copy from scraping Zomato/Swiggy. See WORKFLOW.md for the field-by-field collection guide. Key rules: a Google Maps SEARCH url proves nothing (use the exact /maps/place/ listing URL); directory coordinates are candidates only (evidence_level=directory_reported, they land in bucket 6); listing_rating/listing_review_count are EXTERNAL directory values with a check date — never Foodie community data (community_rating/review_count are forbidden, trigger-maintained); review_decision is your human duplicate-review call after reading the dry-run report ('same_as_existing' requires existing_match_id).

rows.name: Sample Business Name (replace me)
rows.address: Shop 4, Some Building, Main Road (verbatim from the listing)
rows.menu_notes: Only what a reliable public source shows; leave empty otherwise
rows.uncertainty_notes: Anything unclear: same-name businesses nearby, stale listing, pin looks offset, etc.
rows.notes: Where this row came from and anything a reviewer should check
